p5_b0.ocr: In the analysis of Mastercard Inc.'s performance metrics for January 2024, several financial ratios and performance indicators are highlighted. The Profitability Indices show a Return on Equity (ROE) of 15.2% and an Operating Margin of 10.5%, while the Net Profit Margin stands at 6.8%. The Debt Metrics indicate a P/E Ratio of 22.5, a Current Ratio of 1.8, and a Debt/Equity ratio of 0.35.

p5_b1.ocr: A second set of metrics reveals an increase in ROE to 16.5%, with an Operating Margin of 11.0% and a Net Profit Margin of 7.0%. Regarding compliance and regulatory costs, the Cost Breakdown for India reflects a total of ₹1500M with a Yearly Change of 5%, representing 40% of the overall costs, while the percentage change is recorded at 12% and is forecasted to remain stable.
